name: Gladly
description: Gladly is a customer-service platform for people-centered support, conversations, messaging, voice, routing, scheduling, automation, knowledge, and service operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Gladly organization, dedicated API-user email, and customer-owned API token, then let selected agents use content-free business-hours operations or approved documented REST API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: GLADLY_ORGANIZATION
credentialRequirements.label: Gladly organization
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the organization name before .gladly.com; custom hosts and sandbox origins are not accepted.

credentialRequirements.name: GLADLY_AGENT_EMAIL
credentialRequirements.label: Gladly API-user agent email
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the email address of a dedicated Gladly agent with the API User permission.

credentialRequirements.name: GLADLY_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Gladly API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a token for the dedicated API user. Gladly shows a new token only once.

capabilities.label: Read business-hours operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded schedule configuration metadata without names, schedule blocks, exceptions, agents, customers, conversations, messages, contacts, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Gladly REST API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented tenant-bound REST API v1 paths and methods allowed by the connected API user's permissions.

approvalRequired.label: List business-hours metadata
approvalRequired.description: List a bounded set of content-free Gladly business-hours configuration summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read business-hours metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Gladly business-hours configuration through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Gladly REST API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Gladly REST API v1 operation authorized by the API user; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free schedule reads and every broader REST API operation require approval; tenant/version binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, API-user permissions, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected API-user-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; tenant/version binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, bounds, audits, and Gladly limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API-user email and token only to the tenant-bound Gladly REST API v1 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API-user email and token only to the tenant-bound Gladly REST API v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Gladly organization plus a dedicated agent email and API token with API User permission are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Grant API User permission to a dedicated agent, create its one-time-view token, enter the organization/email/token in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, rate limits, token rotation, permission removal, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Gladly's official REST reference defines tenant-specific HTTPS origins, token-based Basic authentication using agent email plus API token, API User permissions, REST API v1 paths, business-hours list/single endpoints, response models, versioning, and rate limits.
